clips.title: The story
paras: Outside Aldrassil in Shadowglen, Melithar Staghelm guides young night elves. He sends them to learn why the dryad Tarindrella has returned to the glade. His Staghelm name links him to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm, though their connection is unknown.

Melithar Staghelm waits outside Aldrassil, where night elves first step into the world. A druid who listens to the forest spirits, he has learned that Tarindrella, a woodland protector, has returned to Shadowglen after years away. Sensing trouble, Melithar sends newcomers southwest of Aldrassil to find the dryad and learn why she has come back to the grove.

The Staghelm name draws notice because Archdruid Fandral Staghelm leads the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus, after Malfurion Stormrage disappeared into the Emerald Dream. Melithar makes no claim to a grand heritage and says nothing of his lineage. Whether he belongs to the Archdruid's family or shares an ancient Kaldorei name remains unknown. For now, Melithar tends to his humble duties at the roots of Aldrassil.
